about: Verified Facts publishers listed on https://databutler.dev/facts/publishers. Add one entry per publisher (facts: its /.well-known/facts.json URL). The Monday job (scripts/check-publishers.js, .github/workflows/watch-sources.yml) runs the conformance checker against each and writes data/publisher-checks.json; the page shows the level the check reached, never the level a site declares.
